public_health_question.v: What were the numbers, incidence, characteristics and outcomes of nationally notifiable domestic arboviral disease cases reported in the United States in 2022?

ev.q: This report summarizes nationally notifiable arboviral diseases reported to CDC for 2022.
West Nile Virus and Other Nationally Notifiable Arboviral Diseases — United States, 2022
Forty-seven cases of Powassan virus disease were reported from 39 counties in nine states.
Thirty-three cases of St. Louis encephalitis virus disease were reported from 12 counties in three states.
Twenty-two cases of La Crosse virus disease were reported from 19 counties in five states.
Among 12 cases of Jamestown Canyon virus disease reported from 12 counties in five states
One case of eastern equine encephalitis virus disease was reported.
Surveillance data are obtained from ArboNET, the national surveillance system for arboviral diseases.
